comparison.objective: Press a smoke alarm TEST button beyond its threshold and allow it to spring back.
comparison.physical_skill: Thresholded button press-and-release, not narrow-tool alignment, hammer impact, or loose-fragment collection.
comparison.success_condition: Button crosses its actuation threshold and returns; the numeric threshold is not supplied.
comparison.reason: A reversible button verification is meaningfully different from irreversible tang fracture and containment.
